articles.summary: Oct 12, 2023. "With APIs, the level of tooling needed to demonstrate the magic of your product is a lot of work. The engineers needed to build, maintain and troubleshoot. Those engineers could either be working on that demo tooling or making our product better. The decision was easy for us: we could dedicate engineers to build and maintain this QA tool or focus on improving our core product."
articles.title: How Column Tax grows 200% with scalable API demos
